What do you see instead? I expect minified code, but an error is thrown instead. What version of the product are you using? On what operating system? appspot Please provide any additional information below. Division by zero is a perfectly sane operation in ECMAScript. See 11.5.2 [0] of the ECMAScript 5 specification. Aliased division by zero `(n=1)/0` is permitted. [0] http://es5.github.com/#x11.5.2","timestamp":1300227573,"attachments":[]},{"id":1,"commenterId":-5060162230523776870,"content":"In what way does this cause a problem?
